text: Ministry of IT & Digital Affairs IT Certificates How to apply for an IT certificate? Fill the online form and upload your NIC copy. Processing takes 5-7 business days.

metadata.question: How to apply for an IT certificate?
metadata.answer: Fill the online form and upload your NIC copy. Processing takes 5-7 business days.

text: Ministry of IT & Digital Affairs IT Certificates What documents are required? You need: NIC copy, passport-size photo, educational certificates, and proof of address.

metadata.question: What documents are required?
metadata.answer: You need: NIC copy, passport-size photo, educational certificates, and proof of address.

text: Ministry of IT & Digital Affairs Digital Services Registration How to register for government digital services? Create an account on portal.gov.lk using your email and NIC. Verify your email to activate.

metadata.question: How to register for government digital services?
metadata.answer: Create an account on portal.gov.lk using your email and NIC. Verify your email to activate.

text: Ministry of Education School Registration How to register a child in government school? Visit the nearest school with birth certificate, NIC copies of parents, and proof of address. Registration is free.

metadata.question: How to register a child in government school?

text: Ministry of Education Exam Results How to check O/L and A/L results? Visit exam.gov.lk and enter your index number. Results are published within 3 months of exams.

metadata.question: How to check O/L and A/L results?
metadata.answer: Visit exam.gov.lk and enter your index number. Results are published within 3 months of exams.

text: Land Registry Department Land Title Search How to obtain land title certificate? Submit application at district land registry with deed number, NIC, and payment of Rs. 1000. Processing takes 2 weeks.

metadata.question: How to obtain land title certificate?
metadata.answer: Submit application at district land registry with deed number, NIC, and payment of Rs. 1000. Processing takes 2 weeks.

metadata.answer: Visit the divisional secretariat website or use the government directory.

text: Ministry of Public Administration Grama Niladhari Services How to obtain a character certificate? Submit a request to your Grama Niladhari with a police report and NIC copy.

metadata.question: How to obtain a character certificate?
metadata.answer: Submit a request to your Grama Niladhari with a police report and NIC copy.

text: Ministry of Health Hospital Clinics How to register for a clinic? Visit the OPD with your referral letter.

metadata.answer: Visit the OPD with your referral letter.

text: Ministry of Housing Housing Loans How to apply for government housing loan? Applications are available at the district office.

metadata.question: How to apply for government housing loan?
metadata.answer: Applications are available at the district office.

text: Ministry of Transport Driving License Services How to apply for a new driving license? Visit the Department of Motor Traffic (DMT) with your NIC, birth certificate, and medical certificate. You must pass the written and practical exams.

metadata.question: How to apply for a new driving license?
metadata.answer: Visit the Department of Motor Traffic (DMT) with your NIC, birth certificate, and medical certificate. You must pass the written and practical exams.

text: Ministry of Transport Driving License Services How to renew my driving license? Renewals can be done at DMT offices or selected Divisional Secretariats. Bring your old license and a medical certificate.

metadata.question: How to renew my driving license?
metadata.answer: Renewals can be done at DMT offices or selected Divisional Secretariats. Bring your old license and a medical certificate.

text: Ministry of Transport Vehicle Registration How to transfer vehicle ownership? Submit MTA 6 and MTA 8 forms along with the vehicle book (CR) and revenue license to the DMT.

metadata.question: How to transfer vehicle ownership?
metadata.answer: Submit MTA 6 and MTA 8 forms along with the vehicle book (CR) and revenue license to the DMT.

text: Department of Immigration & Emigration Passport Services How to apply for a passport? Book an appointment online via the department website. Visit the Battaramulla office with NIC, birth certificate, and photos.

metadata.question: How to apply for a passport?
metadata.answer: Book an appointment online via the department website. Visit the Battaramulla office with NIC, birth certificate, and photos.

text: Department of Immigration & Emigration Passport Services What are the fees for a passport? Normal service: LKR 5,000 (30 days). One-day service: LKR 20,000.

metadata.question: What are the fees for a passport?
metadata.answer: Normal service: LKR 5,000 (30 days). One-day service: LKR 20,000.
